sentences.text: Yantaloong exhibits a unique mix of derived traits found in dicraeosaurines and titanosaurs alongside primitive traits of basal eusauropods.
Zhang and colleagues described this animal from fossils found in the Zhanghe Formation in China.
The authors preferred a classification placing Yantaloong within Turiasauria based on an analysis showing the highest stability.
Yantaloong lived during the Middle Jurassic period.

If Yantaloong is classified as a turiasaur, it would be the first known turiasaur from East Asia. Some analyses suggest Yantaloong could be a non-neosauropod eusauropod outside traditional Turiasauria or a member of Neosauropoda, though these hypotheses are less favored. Yantaloong is likely the first discovered turiasaurian sauropod in China and East Asia.
